analyses.timepoint_policy: Use each source-defined mortality window and retain its duration and analysis population.

rules: Select one complete immune-product versus eligible control mortality record per independent influenza RCT.
Require source-reported death counts and denominators in both arms.
Exclude target-review rows, target combined effects, observational comparisons, and source populations with undocumented denominators.

method_selection_policy: After identifying eligible independent evidence, select and justify a synthesis approach from the study data. The participant package does not prescribe a computation method.
